required_sections.heading: 👀 Progress
required_sections.style: One bullet per app: App: ~N% Implemented | ~N% Accepted. Give useful rough engineering point estimates when measured values are unavailable and label them clearly as estimates, not audited completion. Implemented covers applicable specification/donor behaviour present in the current integrated candidate; Accepted estimates the portion of applicable app scope independently validated. Ground judgment in current source, actual behaviour, retained review evidence and known gaps; record source/revision, date and brief basis. Use measured values when a complete current applicable manifest supports auditable numerators/denominators and stage evidence. Do not copy illustrative values, derive app percentages from test/task pass ratios or quality-gate counts, or count private unintegrated fixes. Not Started requires verified absence. Partial/estimated Accepted percentages do not establish app readiness or waive mandatory gates.

required_sections.heading: 9️⃣ 9to1 Progress
required_sections.style: One bullet per app summarising changes since the last successfully sent email; No Changes when accurate. Show previous→new values for consistent app scope, label estimated movement and explain recalibration or scope changes. Prefer user-facing outcomes; do not invent a measured gain.
